description: Raw JSON text (NOT an already-parsed object) containing a duplicate object key ('version' appears twice). Per spec section 2f, any implementation that deserializes raw JSON text before canonicalizing/verifying an artifact must reject this outright, rather than silently keeping the first or last occurrence of 'version'. This does not exercise message_integrity.proofs.canonicalize directly (which takes an already-parsed dict, and a dict cannot have a duplicate key by construction) -- it exercises message_integrity.proofs.strict_json_loads, the strict-parsing helper for any transport that does hand an implementation raw JSON text.
